title.zh: EAGLE-4让Qwen生成速度提升3.6倍，手机CPU也能提速3倍
title.en: EAGLE-4让Qwen生成速度提升3.6倍，手机CPU也能提速3倍

current_state.zh: Eagle released EAGLE-4 speculative decoding, claiming 3.6x faster Qwen3.8-27B generation on B300 GPUs, 34% higher concurrent throughput, and 3.2x CPU-only speedup on mobile, published under a new restrictive commercial license rather than Apache 2.0.
